Plugin.Name: unMotion
Plugin.Overview: Clone VMs locally, migrate between paired Unraid hosts, and maintain scheduled ZFS replicas with coordinated manual recovery. Cold Move and Warm Move support ZFS and sparse file transfers; independent Warm Moves can run concurrently, but still require a powered-off final cutover. Pairing uses restricted SSH operations and requires protocol 7 on both hosts. Recovery requires dedicated ZFS storage, Guest Agent evidence and a reachable, stopped source; native libvirt fencing rejects unauthorized starts before QEMU runs. Use unMotion controls to start recovery-managed VMs. Reviewable problem reports include logs and VM/host details. No live migration or automatic failover. Keep verified backups and follow the coordinated upgrade guide.
